info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Telecom Sim Esim Provision-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the bulk provisioning of telecom SIM and eSIM devices, enabling efficient management of mobile connectivity. Businesses can utilize this endpoint to register multiple SIM cards or eSIMs simultaneously, streamlining operations for telecom providers and MVNOs. Typical consumers include system integrators and telecom operators looking to enhance their customer onboarding processes. By leveraging this API, organizations can significantly reduce manual intervention and improve resource allocation in device management.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to provision an eSIM for a device, enabling mobile connectivity. It involves submitting relevant information to generate and activate the eSIM profile on the user's device.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the provisioning process for an eSIM. It should contain all necessary information required for the operation, structured as defined in the accompanying schema.
